source_text: Ponebat velamen super faciem. Cum intraret ad Dominum, deponebat. Velamen — littera tegens gloriam; in Christo aufertur.
pass_a_gloss: He-was-placing veil over face. When he-entered to Lord, he-was-removing. Veil — letter covering glory; in Christ is-taken-away.
pass_b_english: He [[put a veil over his face >> Bible:Exodus 34:33]]; entering to the Lord he removed it. The veil is the letter covering glory; [[in Christ it is taken away >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:14-16]].
